prestate.note: M1b K5 (review R4b S5, ruling 2026-11-17): the Python Launcher stays installed and the removed Python used it too. Its objects that existed before snap 0 and are still there after the uninstall are not in the diff, so truth/m1b.sh (prestate) adds every such object these rules match as a kept_owner truth item (top-most match; never one that holds a leftover or user_data truth item). Product rules expand per ARP entry named by `products` that is in lists-0 and lists-2 with the same key and product code. Hand-written; mk_labels.py keeps it.
